feeds.title: Dr. Psych Mom
feeds.description: Dr. Psych mom blogs about relationships, parenting, sex, and more. Featured on The Huffington Post, The Washington Post, Scary Mommy, and more. Dr. Samantha Rodman, aka 'Dr. Psych Mom,' is a clinical psychologist originally from Brooklyn, NY, and now practicing online (from Maryland).

feeds.title: The Modern Mommy Doc Blog
feeds.description: Create a happy home, have fun with your kids, and learn how to thrive in motherhood with practical, smart solutions from the Modern Mommy Doc Blog. I'm Whitney - a pediatrician, mom, author & speaker.

feeds.title: Dr. Alison Mitzner
feeds.description: Dr. Alison Mitzner is a board certified pediatrician and family wellness expert, fitness and lifestyle enthusiast, writer, media contributor who has a calming influence and helps parents feel more confident about their abilities to care for their families.

feeds.title: The Pediatrician Mom Blog
feeds.description: Realistic and thoughtful parenting advice from a pediatrician. Find some peace, some answers, and hopefully some confidence to trust your gut as a parent as you explore some of the common questions and issues that come up again and again.

feeds.title: Life of Dr. Mom Blog
feeds.description: Life of Dr. Mom is designed for the modern mom who struggles with balancing family, work, and fun. With her experience working in women's health, postnatal care, mental health, and Pediatrics. Dr. Mom works to educate the modern mom with the most relevant up-to-date medical evidence to support families and the healthy development of their children.

feeds.title: Doctor Mommy, MD
feeds.description: I'm Shelly; curator and author of Doctor Mommy, MD, a wife, doctor, brand-spankin' new mama. My passion is in helping others live their best lives, both physically and emotionally, and I spend my days doing my best to find ways to be mindful and wholehearted in everything I do!

feeds.title: Paging Dr. Mom
feeds.description: A personal blog with parenting stories and advice from an ER doctor mama. I am Christina Long. This blog came out from my experiences as a mom now to 3 girls (ages 2, 4, and 6yrs) and as an Emergency Medicine physician ('ER doctor') for the past 11 years.

feeds.title: Dr Monique Tello Blog
feeds.description: I'm Monique Tello M.D. M.P.H. My writing generally focuses on a healthy lifestyle, which includes nutrition, fitness, self-care, and finding balance. I'm an Internal Medicine physician, medical school instructor, researcher, writer, and mother, all stimulating jobs that bring rich experiences.

feeds.title: IntegrativeDrMom Blog
feeds.description: Covers recipes, lifestyle, natural living, and integrative medicine. Dr. Jen is a board certified Emergency Medicine Physician.

feeds.title: The Mrs. The Mommy. The M.D.
feeds.description: Jasmine Johnson's journey navigating matrimony, motherhood, and residency.

feeds.title: Emily Edlynn PhD Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Emily Edlynn. This website offers a parenting 'partner' rather than a parenting 'expert'. I write about the research behind the most basic, yet mystifying, parenting topics in the early years, and I blog about the day-to-day experience of blending instinct with science in this wide, weird world.

feeds.title: Dr. Mom Sage Advice
feeds.description: Dr. Catricia is a board-certified and fellowship-trained Pediatrician. She created this space to empower other moms as she share her parenting experiences as a single mom, entertain you with hilarious toddler stories, keep you informed about pediatric health tips and INSPIRE your faith.

feeds.title: Aspiring Minority DOctor
feeds.description: I'm a goal-driven physician, and happily single mother of one with a passion for food, travel, science, and medicine. This blog consists of my journey through medical school and residency, along with helpful tips for both premedical and medical students alike. I hope it inspires and encourages you to reach for the stars

feeds.title: Good Inside Blog
feeds.description: Follow to get a daily dose of parenting and mental health strategies. Dr. Becky is a clinical psychologist and mom of three. She specializes in helping people cope with anxiety and stress, improve relationship satisfaction and communication, and manage work-life pressures.
